set_aside.subject: owner-only service API listener
set_aside.text: `service_access` Owns: “An owner-only start holds no token and opens no service API”; `instance_lifecycle` Owns: “the owner-only start, which opens the owner interface alone” and “the two surfaces”
set_aside.question: Which module owns and enforces the decision not to open the service API listener in an owner-only start, and which module merely consumes the resulting mode?
options: `configuration` owns detecting owner-only mode and `instance_lifecycle` alone owns listener selection
`service_access` owns suppression of the service API listener
`service_access` and `instance_lifecycle` jointly own the listener decision
set_aside.default_guess: Treat `configuration` as owner of the mode and `instance_lifecycle` as sole owner of which listeners open; make `service_access` own only token identification when the service API exists.
